meta.title: Q family (Klein-four S5) full pre-sweep orbit-dedup measurement + superset-orbit structure verification
meta.implementation: independent third implementation (TypeScript sandbox): D4 canonical form, superset-orbit enumeration, survival legality via verified det3/4x4 concyclicity determinant

csv_children_crosscheck.note: every published remaining child in the CSV is exactly one D4-canonical superset orbit of its S5 family, and its published edge cost equals the recomputed legal-candidate count of the canonical representative - strong structural validation of the published worklist

structural_findings.superset_orbit_count: the number of S6 superset orbits of an S5 equals the number of stabilizer(S5)-orbits of the 116 free cells (measured: 33 for Q / 58 for class4 / 62 for audit_blocked), not 116/|stab| - cells on the stabilizer's fixed lines form smaller orbits
structural_findings.stabilizer_dup_correlation: full-family candidate-orbit duplication: Q (order-4 stabilizer) 41.41% > class4 (order-2) 38.0% >= audit_blocked (order-2) 37.75%; remaining-subset duplication is lower than full-family because fewer children accumulate overlap (class4: 19.86% for the 18 remaining of 58)
structural_findings.dup_growth: within a family the per-child dup count grows with the cumulative union; dup-free children occur when a child's orbit is stabilizer-isolated (several 0-dup orbits appear mid-family in all three families)

recommendation.q_sweep: when the Q engine sweep runs (18 remaining children / cost 1238), apply family-level orbit-level verdict transfer at candidate enumeration: Q has the highest measured family-internal duplication (41.41% full-family); the expected saving on the remaining subset is on the order of the class4 remaining measurement (19.86%) or higher
recommendation.implementation_hint: canonicalize each candidate root (child-orbit representative | 7th stone) under D4; family-level seen-orbit table; transfer WIN/REFUTED verdicts across identical canonical forms; per-orbit legal counts for all 33 Q orbits are published in this file for cost estimation

interpretation_guard.no_verdict_claim: this measurement contains no win/loss verdicts and changes the status of no root
interpretation_guard.full_family_vs_remaining: full-family dup rates (37-41%) describe the complete 33/58/62-orbit families; the engine only sweeps the remaining subsets (18/18/10) whose dup rates are lower (19.86%/12.18% measured for the two reference families)
interpretation_guard.q_remaining_unidentified: which 18 of Q's 33 orbits remain is known to the engine worklist but was not re-derived here; per-orbit data covers all 33 so the transfer table is applicable to any subset
